summary: SAMEIET FJELLGATA GØTEBORGGATA (org. no. 981 494 997) is a condominium (ESEK) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2000-09-28. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 5.1 m and net income was NOK 1.3 m. Board chair: Abdul Hasseb Ahmad; auditor: BDO AS.
